I tried their chicken tikka roll, butter chicken roll, chicken pattice, chicken pizza and chicken burger.
The roll and the pattice are good. No complaints with the roll although the pattice was a little too oily but it did taste good.
The pizza is too small. Smaller than you'd expect for sure. It mostly had the tomato taste in the chicken pizza and I don't remember one piece of chicken getting in my mouth from the pizza. It also kinda felt like rubber and didn't taste very good.
The burger had mayonnaise that didn't taste very good. The patty was okay and didn't taste great either. The bun was stale. It was hard and did not taste good.

The first time i ordered from this place, it was a good experience but the second time wasn't. The food delivered to my was cold for which I don't blame the store but the packaging was not good. I ordered 7 items which were all stuffed inside a single packet and the pattice was not even packed. It was just lying in the bag. No ketchup either. The price is good though which is the reason the experience wasn't so bad.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The Dessert Republic is an aesthetic, cozy and pinterest worthy cafe in Matunga east-exactly opposite to Maheshwari Udyan. Their desserts-especially Bavarian Chocolate Bytes is soo chocolaty, yummy and worth the hype-it's their signature dish afterall. The quantity is amazing for the price. 3. When you enter, you are supposed to smile and enter-it's the key-one of the best part of the entire thing. Similarly, while leaving, wave your hand.
Highly recommended for all dessert lovers.

featured_reviews.review_text:

So please visit and try them

The Bad part:
The sitting option, inside the store, in the AC is limited to only 3 tables. On request too the staff doesn't bring more chair and table inside at the free space, they made a Instagram worthy photo spot but no sitting area which is disappointing.

Secondly, I am sure you will out of curiosity try their deserts once but won't repeat it again because they are expensive and for the quantity feels very expensive, though the taste is good but doesn't have the premium ambiance or presentation or dining experience to charge that premium price.
